  This repository holds release builds, not application source — so the pull requests that
  belong here are documentation ones: README wording, a translation that reads badly in your
  language, a broken link, an inaccurate claim.

  Found a bug in the app itself? That needs an issue, not a PR:
  ../../issues/new/choose

## What this changes

<!-- One or two sentences. If it fixes something that was wrong, say what it said before. -->

## Which files

- [ ] `README.md` (English)
- [ ] `README.zh-CN.md` · `README.fr.md` · `README.es.md` · `README.ru.md` · `README.ar.md`
- [ ] Other:

**If you changed a factual claim in one README, change it in all six.** Six translations that
disagree with each other are worse than one language that is out of date, because there is no
way for a reader to tell which one is current.

## Checks

- [ ] Nothing here is a guess. Version numbers, category counts, timings and file names were
      checked against the app or the release page rather than carried over from memory.
- [ ] No vault contents, paths under a real user folder, or personal data in the diff or in
      any screenshot.
